title: Single asset corpus registry entry
description: Contract for one registry entry: identity and classification of one worktree asset file. Status starts at registered; later M4 slices advance it through extraction and conversion states.

path.description: Repository-relative POSIX path with forward slashes, exactly as walked.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the worktree file bytes (64 lowercase hex characters).

extension.description: Lowercase file extension including the dot (e.g. .swf).

directory_class.description: First path segment (top-level directory) classifying the file location.

status.description: Conversion lifecycle status; this slice only registers.
